label: Ceres system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Ceres locus that can protect bacteria from bacteriophage infection.
observations: Ceres branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual CrsA genes, CrsA proteins, DefenseFinder HMM profiles, predicted source-database rows naming one Ceres locus, unresolved Ceres trigger or effector activities, and other phage defense systems.
